name: Mesh level: a ball rolls down the ramp of a model-file courtyard into a low wall, another comes to rest at the bottom of the pit, crates stay stacked on the platform, a box tumbles down the steps, three convex rocks settle on the floor and a wedge stays on the ramp, the guard walks up the ramp by itself, the hero stands on the floor and is stopped by the wall

expect.name: Ball
expect.message: the ball is rolling down the ramp

expect.name: Ball
expect.message: on the surface of the ramp, not through it

expect.name: Ball
expect.message: the ball ran across the floor and stopped at the low wall (x = 3)

expect.name: Ball
expect.message: and lies on the floor

expect.name: Pit ball
expect.message: the other ball fell into the pit and lies on its floor (2 m down)

expect.name: Pit ball
expect.message: inside the pit

expect.name: Crate 1
expect.message: the bottom crate stands on the platform (1.2 m up)

expect.name: Crate 3
expect.message: and the third is still on top of the other two

expect.name: Tumbler
expect.message: the box slid off the ledge and went down the steps

expect.name: Tumbler
expect.message: and lies on the floor at the bottom

expect.name: Capsule
expect.message: the capsule fell over and lies on the floor (0.2 m radius)

expect.name: Rock 1
expect.message: rock 1 has tumbled and lies on the floor on one of its faces (its centre is between 0.12 and 0.55 m up, whichever face)

expect.name: Rock 2
expect.message: rock 2 has tumbled and lies on the floor on one of its faces (its centre is between 0.17 and 0.77 m up, whichever face)

expect.name: Rock 3
expect.message: rock 3 has tumbled and lies on the floor on one of its faces (its centre is between 0.10 and 0.44 m up, whichever face)

expect.name: Rock 1
expect.message: and is not moving up or down

expect.name: Rock 2
expect.message: and is not moving up or down

expect.name: Rock 3
expect.message: and is not moving up or down

expect.name: Wedge
expect.message: the wedge is still where it was put on the ramp: friction (0.5 against 0.7) is more than the slope's 14 degrees ask for

expect.name: Wedge
expect.message: and lies on the ramp's surface, not in it

expect.name: Guard
expect.message: the guard arrived at its target on the platform

expect.name: Guard
expect.message: walked up the ramp: its feet are on the platform

expect.name: Hero
expect.message: the hero stands on the floor

expect.name: Hero
expect.message: the hero walked west at 4 m/s and was stopped by the low wall (it ends at 3.4 m, its own radius 0.35 m away from it)

expect.name: Hero
expect.message: still on the floor: the wall is higher than the 0.4 m it can step up
